draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Buttery smooth route runner with long, loose strides.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.13, the 3rd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 1st of 35 at WR. He went 10th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Calvin Ridley. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2020) ranked 1st in receiving yards among the 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 80 career games and 78 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 9 AV in 2025 against a career-best 13 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: team target share 24.3% (94th percentile), approximate value 9 (88th percentile), receiving yards 1,008 (88th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 1,008 receiving yards against a median of 255, above the norm.
